key_highlights: ASX closed higher as oil prices and bond yields eased; big four banks (CBA, ANZ, NAB, WBC) advanced on the day
AUD weakened sharply after Fed 'Warshach test' failure, pressuring commodity exporters and importers
IMF urged Australian government to cut spending ahead of a potential RBA rate hike, adding fiscal-policy uncertainty
WA exploration pipeline strengthened: Dalaroo copper-nickel-PGE targets, Critica rare earths carbonate, Augustus 30g/t gold, and Auric Burbanks plant fast-tracked
Coles maintained elevated milk prices while cutting farmer support, signalling persistent consumer-staple margin pressure
Saudi pipeline outage hit an oil market with thin buffers; Middle East oil shock risk elevated
Anthropic secured a $31bn data centre deal in western QLD; coal-fired power debate intensified for energy security
Australian fashion brands Cue and Veronika Maine face collapse; Bathla insolvency triggered broader distress
ACCC moved to break real estate agent monopoly; tenants saw rent relief, positive for REIT occupancy dynamics
BOJ set to raise rates to 31-year high, adding global liquidity headwinds

sectors.trend: Positive exploration momentum in WA (copper, gold, rare earths) offsets near-term commodity price softness; AUD weakness supports exporter revenue
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX benefit from AUD depreciation; small-cap explorers (Critica, Augustus, Auric) see catalyst-driven upside; iron ore demand watch amid China credit expansion

sectors.trend: Big four advanced on easing yields; however, IMF fiscal warning and soaring state interest costs pressure credit growth and NIMs
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, ANZ.AX, NAB.AX, WBC.AX supported by rate-hike expectations but face margin compression risk if RBA pauses; private credit sector (headline 44) a structural concern

sectors.trend: Saudi pipeline outage and Middle East tensions support oil prices; coal-fired power debate for QLD data centres creates policy uncertainty; green hydrogen spending questioned
sectors.implications: Woodside (WDS.AX), Santos (STO.AX) benefit from LNG/oil price support; coal generators face policy risk; Caturus LNG expansion (US) a positive global signal

sectors.trend: Coles sustains milk price premium while cutting farmer support; real wage growth crushed by exploited workers; fashion sector in distress
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WGM.AX face margin pressure from input costs; Cue/Veronika Maine collapse signals consumer discretionary weakness; WES.AX defensive appeal intact

sectors.trend: Tenants see rent relief; ACCC targets real estate agent monopoly; Trump policy risk to Aussie house prices flagged
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) benefit from rent stabilisation; property developers face policy headwinds; monitor RBA housing commentary

sectors.trend: Anthropic $31bn QLD data centre deal and AI infrastructure build-out drive capex; coal power needed to support load
sectors.implications: Energy and construction names benefit; ASX-listed data centre/infrastructure plays gain visibility; AI adoption in media (News Corp) signals sector-wide shift

key_themes: AUD weakness post-Fed decision supports commodity exporters but raises import costs
IMF fiscal warning and potential RBA hike create a hawkish policy backdrop
WA mining exploration pipeline (copper, gold, rare earths) remains a key ASX small/mid-cap catalyst
Energy transition policy conflict: coal for data centres vs green hydrogen spending scrutiny
Consumer squeeze: elevated food prices, weak real wages, fashion sector distress
Global oil supply risk from Middle East and Saudi pipeline outage
BOJ rate hike to 31-year high adds global liquidity tightening
Superannuation structural concerns and private credit risk flagged

risk_assessment.risk_factor: AUD depreciation and Fed policy uncertainty
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge FX exposure; favour AUD-earning commodity names; monitor RBA response
Overweight energy (WDS.AX, STO.AX); hold oil-linked hedges; monitor Saudi pipeline recovery

risk_assessment.risk_factor: IMF fiscal warning / RBA rate hike
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce duration in bonds; favour floating-rate and dividend-paying equities; watch state borrowing costs

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Consumer demand erosion and sector distress
risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight discretionary retail; favour WES.AX, defensive staples; monitor Cue/Veronika Maine contagion

risk_assessment.risk_factor: BOJ rate hike and global liquidity tightening
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce leverage; favour cash-generative large caps; monitor JPY cross impact on AUD
Diversify energy exposure; monitor QLD data centre power contracts and federal policy signals

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight WA exploration and junior miners on exploration catalysts
opportunities.rationale: Dalaroo copper-PGE, Critica rare earths, Augustus 30g/t gold, and Auric Burbanks fast-track create a pipeline of ASX-listed catalysts; AUD weakness boosts revenue

opportunities.recommendation: Add energy exposure on Middle East supply risk
opportunities.rationale: Saudi pipeline outage and thin oil buffers support WDS.AX and STO.AX; Caturus LNG expansion signals structural demand

opportunities.recommendation: Position in big four banks ahead of potential RBA hike
opportunities.rationale: Banks advanced on easing yields; rate hike expectation supports NIMs; CBA.AX and NAB.AX offer dividend yield

opportunities.recommendation: Monitor QLD data centre / AI infrastructure beneficiaries
opportunities.rationale: Anthropic $31bn deal and coal-power debate create capex tailwinds for construction, energy, and infrastructure names

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce exposure to consumer discretionary and fashion
defensive_moves.rationale: Cue and Veronika Maine collapse, weak real wages, and Coles price pressure signal sustained consumer squeeze

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge AUD weakness and rate risk
defensive_moves.rationale: Fed uncertainty, IMF fiscal warning, and BOJ hike create a volatile macro backdrop; favour dividend-paying large caps

defensive_moves.recommendation: Underweight REITs pending ACCC real estate action and rent dynamics
defensive_moves.rationale: ACCC monopoly probe and tenant rent relief could compress REIT yields; monitor GPW.AX, ICPS.AX

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to consolidate near recent highs with volatility from Fed, BOJ, and Middle East oil headlines. Banks and miners lead; consumer and discretionary lag. AUD remains the key swing factor.
market_outlook.long_term: Structural tailwinds from WA mining pipeline, AI/data centre capex, and energy transition support a gradual upward drift. Headwinds from IMF fiscal constraints, weak real wages, and global liquidity tightening cap upside. RBA path is the pivotal variable.
key_catalysts: RBA rate decision and IMF fiscal response
QLD data centre power policy resolution
watch_list: Iron ore, LNG, and gold spot prices
RBA cash rate and CPI print
ASX 200 sector rotation (banks vs miners vs consumer)
Saudi pipeline recovery and Brent crude
BOJ policy decision and JPY cross
